#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Task-local inspection: enumerate the workspace to locate European economic
performance data files and show their contents so the storytelling report can
be grounded in the real dataset."""
import os
from pathlib import Path

root = Path.cwd()
print("ROOT:", root)
for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(root):
    # Skip hidden internals that are not task data.
    dirnames[:] = [d for d in dirnames if not d.startswith(".")]
    for name in sorted(filenames):
        if name.startswith("."):
            continue
        p = Path(dirpath) / name
        rel = p.relative_to(root)
        try:
            data = p.read_bytes()
        except OSError as exc:
            print(f"\n=== {rel} (unreadable: {exc}) ===")
            continue
        print(f"\n=== {rel}  [{len(data)} bytes] ===")
        try:
            text = data.decode("utf-8")
        except UnicodeDecodeError:
            print(data[:400])
            continue
        print(text[:20000])

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Task-local inspection helper: inventory the isolated workspace and surface
candidate European-economic-performance data files for the data storytelling report."""
import os
import sys

ROOT = os.getcwd()
print("PROBE CWD:", ROOT)
print("=" * 70)

skip_dirs = {".git", "__pycache__", ".codex", "node_modules"}
interesting_ext = {".json", ".csv", ".tsv", ".txt", ".md", ".yaml", ".yml", ".log", ".dat"}

entries = []
for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(ROOT):
    dirnames[:] = [d for d in dirnames if d not in skip_dirs and not d.startswith(".")]
    for f in filenames:
        full = os.path.join(dirpath, f)
        try:
            size = os.path.getsize(full)
        except OSError:
            size = -1
        entries.append((full, size))

entries.sort()
print("FILES FOUND (%d):" % len(entries))
for full, size in entries:
    rel = os.path.relpath(full, ROOT)
    print("  %-60s %10d bytes" % (rel, size))

print("=" * 70)
for full, size in entries:
    ext = os.path.splitext(full)[1].lower()
    rel = os.path.relpath(full, ROOT)
    if ext not in interesting_ext:
        continue
    print("\n" + "#" * 70)
    print("FILE:", rel, "(%d bytes)" % size)
    print("#" * 70)
    try:
        with open(full, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as fh:
            data = fh.read()
    except OSError as exc:
        print("  <cannot read: %s>" % exc)
        continue
    if len(data) > 20000:
        print(data[:20000])
        print("\n... [truncated; %d more chars] ..." % (len(data) - 20000))
    else:
        print(data)
    print("#" * 70)

print("\nPROBE COMPLETE")
